flags.why: The fast-flowing-water sense belongs to xiết, not siết, as recorded in [VDict](https://vdict.com/xi%E1%BA%BFt,3,0,0.html).
flags.fix: Move this sense to xiết and change the example to: Nước sông chảy xiết lắm, đừng xuống tắm.

flags.why: Dàn xếp means arranging or settling something satisfactorily, not simply exchanging views ([reference](https://nghengu.vn/tieng-nghe-cua-toi/dan-xep-hay-gian-xep-1750.html)).
flags.fix: Remove sense 3 and retain the settlement meaning under senses 1–2.
